risks.proof: A video clip showing the console booting to the home menu and running a game for 5 minutes.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift or failing batteries.

risks.risk: HDMI or power ports may be damaged.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the rear ports of the console.

Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Video of a game disc being loaded and played.
Close-up photos of the HDMI port and the controller charging ports.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PS4 Fat with two controllers. It can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a non-functional unit until proof of operation is provided.
